Rest breaks evening rules
This section covers one way of working
Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: to support passengers and staff with calm, consistent handling of companion animal travel at Aurelia Skyways.

The desk team gives clear guidance, checks travel papers, and helps the passenger coordinator keep each handover smooth. Staff should listen carefully, speak in plain language, and confirm the passenger's plan before any animal is accepted for travel. If a passenger arrives with concerns, the team should respond kindly and keep the discussion focused on safe, orderly service. When a case needs extra review, the same courteous tone should be used in all updates, and the record should stay accurate and complete. <<FACT F095>> Any arrival pickup issue should be noted in the file and shared with the right colleague without delay.

If an incident is reported, staff must record the facts as they are known, avoid guesswork, and protect the welfare of the passenger and animal first. <<FACT F108>> The matter should then be passed to the next support level through the usual internal channel, with a brief and respectful handover note. Where a passenger such as Andre Muller or Ben Vega needs added reassurance, the desk should keep the conversation practical and steady. If Koda or another pet is involved, the team should support the traveler while following the same safety steps for all companion animals.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk should keep communication warm, accurate, and discreet throughout every contact. For further guidance, contact the senior coordinator.
